name: Five-Act (Freytag)
description: Freytag's pyramid: tension rises to a climax at the centre, then falls to the ending.

acts.title: Exposition
acts.description: The situation before the trouble starts.

beats.name: Exposition
beats.hint: Introduce the characters, the setting and the tension underneath.

acts.title: Rising Action
acts.description: Complications build towards the turning point.

beats.name: Rising action
beats.hint: An exciting force sets things moving; each complication raises the stakes.

acts.title: Climax
acts.description: The turning point of the story.

beats.name: Climax
beats.hint: The moment of highest tension, where the protagonist's fortunes turn.

acts.title: Falling Action
acts.description: Consequences unfold from the turning point.

beats.name: Falling action
beats.hint: The fallout plays out; one last moment of suspense before the end.

beats.name: Dénouement
beats.hint: The outcome settles: triumph, catastrophe or something between.
